text:
alex_sales: Hey team — AcmeCorp's security lead emailed: they want concrete access-control evidence for the POC (SSO/SAML metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC/role mappings, and sample service-account least-privilege policies). They want deliverables by EOD tomorrow. Can we collect a sanitized pack?

mike_security: Yep. I can export SAML metadata + sign-on audit events. We'll need to sanitize tenant IDs and user emails. I can also grab conditional access policy screenshot showing MFA requirement.

lisa_se: For the RBAC piece I can produce a sample role-mapping table and a short explanation of our least-privilege defaults for service accounts. Would a CSV + 1-page PDF be OK?

jane_engineering: I have a small config snippet we can share for SCIM/role sync that shows attribute mappings. It's safe to redact IDs. Example we can include: 
```
{
  "group_attribute": "appRoles",
  "mapping": {
    "saml:role": "redwood:app_role"
  }
}
```

alex_sales: Good. They also asked for evidence of MFA enforcement for non-interactive clients (service accounts) vs interactive users. How do we phrase that?

mike_security: Short answer: interactive sessions require MFA via conditional access; service accounts are non-interactive and use short-lived keys + strict ACLs. I'll draft a paragraph and include a screenshot of the Azure AD conditional access rule: 'Require MFA for interactive sessions' + the enforcement timestamp. We'll redact org names.

lisa_se: On RBAC, include a sample mapping: CSV with columns (role_name,description,default_scoped_resources,permission_examples). We'll include one example role: "ingest-writer" limited to dataset:create, dataset:append.

sam_cs: I'll coordinate delivery and add a cover note for the security reviewer that lists artifacts and redaction notes. Also can offer a Loom walkthrough for any follow-up. :+1:

alex_sales: Perfect. Can we put together the artifact list now so I can reply to AcmeCorp? Need to be explicit.

mike_security: Artifact list (we will provide sanitized versions):
- SAML metadata XML (signed)
- SSO SAML flow diagram (png)
- Conditional Access screenshot showing MFA requirement (png)
- Auth audit snippet (last 30 days) redacted (CSV)
- SCIM provisioning mapping example (json)
- RBAC role-mapping CSV + sample policy examples (csv + md)
- Service-account policy example (HCL or json) showing least-privilege and key rotation cadence
- Statement of 'no shared root credentials' + rotation docs (pdf)

jane_engineering: I'll attach a short sample service-account policy we use internally: 
```
# service-account example (JSON)
{
  "id": "sa-ingest-01",
  "permissions": ["dataset:create","dataset:append"],
  "scoped_resources": ["project:acme:data-ingest"],
  "key_rotation_days": 7
}
```

mike_security: Also will include a link to our compliance page (internal) and note on SSO providers supported: Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin. We'll state 'MFA enforced via IdP or conditional access at account level; token policies applied to machine credentials.'

alex_sales: Great. Two quick Qs before I reply to the customer: 1) Are we comfortable sharing sanitized audit CSV with event types? 2) Do we have a standard redaction template?

lisa_se: Yes on CSV with event types (login, token_issue, admin_change) and obfuscate principal -> use hashed identifier. I have a redaction template I'll attach.

mike_security: I have a scrub script. It replaces emails with <user_hash> and strips tenant IDs. I'll run it and commit artifacts to a staging S3 link. Will mark the bundle with a checksum.

sam_cs: I'll draft the reply: include artifact list, redaction statement, offer a short technical call + Loom. Want me to send now or wait for the final artifacts?

alex_sales: Hold — wait for artifacts so I can link them in my reply. ETA for me to respond is tomorrow morning if we have the bundle tonight.

mike_security: Plan: I'll push artifacts by 21:00 UTC. Steps: export SAML XML -> run redaction -> generate audit CSV (30d) -> take CA screenshot -> drop into staging and post link.

lisa_se: I'll prepare RBAC CSV + one-page role explanation and attach the redaction template.

jane_engineering: I'll add SCIM mapping snippet and service-account JSON.

sam_cs: I'll prepare cover note and Loom script.

deploy-bot: deploy report: artifacts-staging-bucket -> upload complete (staging/redacted-acme-poc-194555). SHA256: abcdef... :white_check_mark:

alex_sales: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll send an update to AcmeCorp once I have the staging link. If they ask for live demo of role mappings we can schedule during the POC.

mike_security: FYI — if they request raw logs later we require an additional NDA for full audit exports. I'll mention that in the cover note.

alex_sales: Good call. Closing this thread when bundle is uploaded.

sam_cs: Noted. :rocket:
